verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-table row for "Bring your own keys", available on higher tiers. It does not say these are LLM provider keys or which providers or models are supported. The OpenAI CUA integration guide shows Notte can work with one external vendor's agent, which hints at but does not establish model-agnosticism. missing for 10: explicit documentation that BYO keys means LLM provider keys, a list of supported LLM providers/models, SDK configuration for choosing a model, availability on all plans, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bring my own LLM provider — the framework is model-agnostic rather than locked to one vendor's models

citations.quote: This guide explains how to integrate OpenAI's Computer Use Agent (CUA) with Notte's browser infrastructure for automated web interactions.
